title: About Us: AI Product Photos and Video Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo into store images and short video ads for a small shop, with no studio, no casting, and private uploads. See how it works.
h1: About AIVideosUGC: Product Visuals Made Simple
lead: AIVideosUGC helps a small shop make product photos and short video ads from one product photo or a product page link. You can add an actor, a script, a spoken line, and captions, then review the file in your account instead of booking a shoot.
secondary_keywords: product content tool for Etsy shops

paras: Upload a picture of what you sell, or paste a product page link. Pick a template or describe the scene, and download a square store image or a short video of 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

In a typical week that means a clean listing shot, a lifestyle photo, a model photo for clothing, a feed image, and a vertical clip. The clip can carry an actor, a script, a spoken line, and captions. No design software, no agency booking, and no studio day.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a blonde chin-length bob sets a plain ceramic mug on paper beside a closed laptop.

sections.h2: How to Make a Product Ad in 3 Simple Steps
paras: Upload a photo or paste the product page link, and add one line about the buyer.
The tool writes the script, adds an actor, a voice, and captions, and can make a batch of versions.
Check the product, then download the file or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook.

sections.h2: Features You Can Use on an Ad
paras: Pick an actor from the library, or build a presenter from photos you have the rights to, and reuse that presenter on the next video. The actor can say the line in more than one language.
Captions come with the clip and you can edit the words. A music library sits in the tool, and the editor lets you trim the clip, swap the actor, and change the line without another app.
Paste a product page link to start a video, make a batch of versions from one photo, or send a job from your own software through the API. Each job shows its credit cost before it starts.

sections.h2: AI visuals for Shopify sellers and small shops
paras: It is built for small shops on Shopify, Amazon, and Etsy, and for the people who run their ads. Sellers who ship goods they do not keep in stock, small businesses, marketers, creators, and app teams use the same tools when they need a file this week.

You do not need editing skills. A clear product photo and one sentence about the scene are enough to start. It is a product content tool for Etsy shops when a listing changes and you need a new image or clip.
sections.alt: Adult small-shop owner prepares a plain product for a listing at a packing table.

sections.h2: A private AI product photo tool
paras: Everything you upload and everything you make stays in your own account. Your product photos and results are not shown to other customers or published.
Some requests are turned down, including celebrities or other public figures, and logos or trademarks that belong to someone else. Keep the image or clip on a product you sell.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a copper-red low bun sits by a closed laptop and a small brass padlock.

sections.h2: Credit costs on screen before you start
paras: Every photo and video shows its credit cost before the job starts, so you see the price before anything is spent. Plans start at $24.50 a month with 200 credits. Pro is $35 with 300 credits, and Premium is $63 with 600.

Credits are held while a job runs and used when the file arrives. A delivered file is not refunded, which is why the cost is on screen first. If a job fails, the credits return to your balance on their own. A batch charges each version.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a short silver crop reviews plain wooden tokens beside a closed laptop.

faq.q: Can I make product ads without hiring an agency?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your product photo or paste a product page link, add an actor and a script if you want them, and download the file or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook. There is no booking and no shoot day.

faq.q: How do I reach the team?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. That is the way to reach the team.

Upload a product photo for an image. For a video, upload a product photo or paste a product page link, then describe the scene. You can also add a script, a spoken line, and captions. Compare the result with the real item before you publish it.
Online sellers and marketers who need product photos and short ad videos from their own product photos, without a studio or an agency.

Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits. Pro is $35 with 300 credits, and Premium is $63 with 600. Each photo or video shows its credit cost before the job starts. If a job fails, its credits come back on their own.

faq.q: Can I reuse a presenter on the next video?
faq.a: Yes. Pick an actor from the library, or build a presenter from photos you have the rights to, and use that same presenter on the next video. See [AI spokesperson video](page:spokesperson-videos).

faq.q: Does the video include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. A short ad can include a spoken line, captions you can edit, and a track from the music library. You can change them in the editor before you download.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Send the finished file to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from the tool, or download it and post it yourself. There is no watermark.

faq.q: Is there an API, and is there a free plan?
faq.a: Your own software can send a job through the API. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need access. There is no free plan. Plans start at $24.50 a month with 200 credits.
